notes: Stories created for Specialty Match Accuracy feature.

EVAL-P-M2-S1.title: Define Specialty Match Accuracy Schema and Contract
EVAL-P-M2-S1.description: Define structured schema for specialty match output including NUCC codes, match score, confidence level, and explanation fields for how the match was derived.

EVAL-P-M2-S2.title: Implement Specialty Match Accuracy Logic
EVAL-P-M2-S2.description: Compute match accuracy between user condition and provider specialties using NUCC taxonomy, leveraging existing dual-pipeline (regex + vector) outputs and aggregating to a normalized score.

EVAL-P-M2-S3.title: Expose Specialty Match Accuracy via Evaluate Care Facade
EVAL-P-M2-S3.description: Integrate specialty match accuracy into provider evaluation response and expose through evaluate_care_facade for downstream chat consumption.

EVAL-P-M2-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Specialty Match Accuracy
EVAL-P-M2-S4.description: Create unit tests for scoring logic and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from specialty identification through evaluate care response.
